GE.EQUILIBRIUM_DERIVATIVE

Equation 5 (p. 4); Section 2 (starts p. 3); Section A (starts p. 15)

eq:equilibrium factor clearing · Source lines 100–104, 549–558

proved_and_semantically_reviewed

Real finite n,k; positive benchmark prices and inputs; existing Frame; arbitrary demand with x(p)=q and HasFDerivAt x (-D) p. Current prices vary; baseline shares and C are fixed. Positive Model candidate. Economic K positivity additionally uses positive q and total inputs, fixed parent report, SPD D and sigma>0. K invertibility follows from the economic regularity theorem. A differentiable path through the benchmark, with physical clearing on a neighborhood of zero, plus the economic solution assumptions. This unit gives derivative formulas for a supplied path; GE.LOCAL_EXISTENCE constructs the path.

Automatic-pass and zero-variance results allow epsilon=0. No assumption of strictly positive residual variance.

PREC.DECISION_TABLE.ROWS_AND_NOTES

Table 1 (p. 12); Section 5.4 (starts p. 11)

tab:precisiondecisions · Source lines 421–454

proved_and_semantically_reviewed

Original known-sigma Precision.Data. Capacity upper certificates require type-preserving groups; all-group lower failure applies to arbitrary partitions. Conditional claims use an admissible observation. Largest-product isolation permits at most min(k,n)+2 groups. Residual-Q necessity requires nonzero fixed theta and eta!=sigma. Abstract straddling is only a logical statement about lower/upper certificates.

CommodityClassification.FixedAnswer.hasDerivAt_schurResidual

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/AllAnswerDifferentialTools.lean:32

∀ {k r s v : ℕ}
  {A : ℝ → CommodityClassification.FixedAnswer.Mat r k} {B : ℝ → CommodityClassification.FixedAnswer.Mat s k}
  {K : ℝ → CommodityClassification.FixedAnswer.Mat k k} (S : CommodityClassification.FixedAnswer.Mat r s)
  (P : CommodityClassification.FixedAnswer.Mat r v) (Q : CommodityClassification.FixedAnswer.Mat s v)
  (V X : CommodityClassification.FixedAnswer.Mat v k) {t : ℝ},
  HasDerivAt A (P * X) t →
    HasDerivAt B (Q * X) t →
      HasDerivAt K (Matrix.transpose V * X + Matrix.transpose X * V) t →
        IsUnit (Matrix.det (K t)) →
          Matrix.transpose (K t)⁻¹ = (K t)⁻¹ →
            HasDerivAt (fun z => S - A z * (K z)⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose (B z))
              (-((P - A t * (K t)⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose V) * X * (K t)⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose (B t)) -
                A t * (K t)⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose X * Matrix.transpose (Q - B t * (K t)⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose V))
              t

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

                            1 ∧
                          (CommodityClassification.Regularity.K p q D R σ C)⁻¹ *
                              CommodityClassification.Regularity.K p q D R σ C =
                            1

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

GE.REGULARITY · GE.REGULARITY.CANDIDATES

CommodityClassification.Regularity.fixedAnswer_K_posDef_on

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/CandidateRegularity.lean:78

∀ {n k g r : ℕ}
  (e : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Frame k) (P : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Partition n g)
  (p q : CommodityClassification.Regularity.Vec n) (J : CommodityClassification.Regularity.Mat g k)
  (Cref C0 : CommodityClassification.Regularity.Mat n k) (D : CommodityClassification.Regularity.Mat n n) (σ : ℝ)
  (b : CommodityClassification.Regularity.Vec n) (N : CommodityClassification.Regularity.Mat n r)
  (U : Set (CommodityClassification.Regularity.Mat r k)),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < p i) →
    (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < q i) →
      (∀ (j : Fin (k + 1)), 0 < e.w j) →
        (∀ (j : Fin (k + 1)), 0 < CommodityClassification.Supply.totalInputs q (e.reconstruct p Cref) j) →
          Cref ∈ e.Candidates p q P J →
            Matrix.PosDef D →
              0 < σ →
                (∀ Z ∈ U, C0 + N * Z ∈ e.Candidates p q P J) →
                  have a :=
                    CommodityClassification.Regularity.fixedAnswerData p q D
                      (CommodityClassification.Supply.candidateR e p q Cref) σ b C0 N;
                  ∀ Z ∈ U, Matrix.PosDef (a.K (a.point Z))

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/CESProductionApplication.lean:19

∀ {n k : ℕ}
  (E : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Model n k),
  0 < E.sigma →
    ∀ {w : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec (k + 1)},
      w ∈ CommodityClassification.CESCost.PositivePrices (k + 1) →
        ∀ (i : Fin n) {y : ℝ},
          0 ≤ y →
            E.ProductionFeasible i y (y • E.currentInputs w i) ∧
              w ⬝ᵥ y • E.currentInputs w i = y * E.costs w i ∧
                IsLeast {e | ∃ x, E.ProductionFeasible i y x ∧ w ⬝ᵥ x = e} (y * E.costs w i) ∧
                  (∀ (z : ℝ) (x : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec (k + 1)),
                      E.ProductionFeasible i z x → E.costs w i * z - w ⬝ᵥ x ≤ 0) ∧
                    E.costs w i * y - w ⬝ᵥ y • E.currentInputs w i = 0

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

          E.frame.w ⬝ᵥ E.q i • E.A i = E.q i * E.p i ∧
            IsLeast {e | ∃ x, E.ProductionFeasible i (E.q i) x ∧ E.frame.w ⬝ᵥ x = e} (E.q i * E.p i) ∧
              (∀ (z : ℝ) (x : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec (k + 1)),
                  E.ProductionFeasible i z x → E.p i * z - E.frame.w ⬝ᵥ x ≤ 0) ∧
                E.p i * E.q i - E.frame.w ⬝ᵥ E.q i • E.A i = 0

CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.BenchmarkFamily.composite_competitive_path

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/CompositeCompetitivePaths.lean:14

∀ {n k h g : ℕ}
  (F : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.BenchmarkFamily n k h)
  (P : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Partition n g) (β : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec g)
  (C : F.Candidate),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (s0 c : ℝ),
      0 < s0 →
        have E := F.compositeModel P β C;
        ∃ u s,
          E.PositiveLocalPath s0 u s ∧
            (∃ I,
                IsOpen I ∧
                  0 ∈ I ∧
                    ∀ t ∈ I,
                      E.CompetitiveState (F.compositeUtility P c) Set.univ (F.commonEndowment s0) (t, u t) (s t)) ∧
              HasDerivAt u E.zSolution 0 ∧
                HasDerivAt s E.sSolution 0 ∧
                  HasDerivAt (fun t => E.quantities (t, u t)) E.qSolution 0 ∧
                    E.WelfareExpansion (F.compositeUtility P c) u s

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/CompositeCompetitivePaths.lean:44

∀ {n k h g : ℕ}
  (F : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.BenchmarkFamily n k h)
  (P : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Partition n g) (B : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Mat g g)
  (hD : F.D = F.sigma • CommodityClassification.Supply.xi F.p F.q + P.Q F.q * B * Matrix.transpose (P.Q F.q))
  (C : F.Candidate),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (s0 c : ℝ),
      0 < s0 →
        (F.matchedModel P B hD C).BenchmarkEquilibrium (F.matchedUtility P c) (F.commonEndowment s0) s0 ∧
          ∃ u s,
            (F.matchedModel P B hD C).PositiveLocalPath s0 u s ∧
              (∃ I,
                  IsOpen I ∧
                    0 ∈ I ∧
                      ∀ t ∈ I,
                        (F.matchedModel P B hD C).CompetitiveState (F.matchedUtility P c) {x | ∀ (i : Fin n), 0 ≤ x i}
                          (F.commonEndowment s0) (t, u t) (s t)) ∧
                HasDerivAt u (F.model C).zSolution 0 ∧
                  HasDerivAt (fun t => (F.matchedModel P B hD C).quantities (t, u t)) (F.model C).qSolution 0 ∧
                    (F.matchedModel P B hD C).WelfareExpansion (F.matchedUtility P c) u s

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

      (η a - F.sigma) • (F.nestData G η hη).nestCovariance (↑C) a

CommodityClassification.CESCost.input_cost_formulas

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/CostInputConnection.lean:28

∀ {n f : ℕ} (A : CommodityClassification.CESCost.Mat n f)
  (p : CommodityClassification.CESCost.Vec n) (w0 : CommodityClassification.CESCost.Vec f)
  (hA : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Positive A) (hp : ∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < p i)
  (hw : ∀ (j : Fin f), 0 < w0 j) (hc : Matrix.mulVec A w0 = p) (σ : ℝ) (i : Fin n),
  have d := CommodityClassification.CESCost.ofInputs A p w0 hA hp hw hc i;
  d.cost σ w0 = p i ∧
    (∀ w ∈ CommodityClassification.CESCost.PositivePrices f, ContDiffAt ℝ ⊤ (d.cost σ) w) ∧
      (∀ (u : CommodityClassification.CESCost.Vec f), (fderiv ℝ (d.cost σ) w0) u = A i ⬝ᵥ u) ∧
        (∀ (j l : Fin f),
            CommodityClassification.CESCost.pricePartial (CommodityClassification.CESCost.pricePartial (d.cost σ) j) l
                w0 =
              σ * (A i j * A i l / p i - if j = l then A i j / w0 j else 0)) ∧
          ∀ (u v : CommodityClassification.CESCost.Vec f),
            (fderiv ℝ (fun w => (fderiv ℝ (d.cost σ) w) v) w0) u =
              σ * (A i ⬝ᵥ u * A i ⬝ᵥ v / p i - ∑ j, A i j / w0 j * u j * v j)

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/CostInputConnection.lean:65

∀ {n k : ℕ}
  (e : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Frame k) (p : CommodityClassification.CESCost.Vec n)
  (C : CommodityClassification.CESCost.Mat n k) (hp : ∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < p i) (hw : ∀ (j : Fin (k + 1)), 0 < e.w j)
  (hC : C ∈ e.PositiveDomain p) (σ : ℝ) (i : Fin n),
  have d := CommodityClassification.CESCost.ofCoordinates e p C hp hw hC i;
  d.cost σ e.w = p i ∧
    (∀ w ∈ CommodityClassification.CESCost.PositivePrices (k + 1), ContDiffAt ℝ ⊤ (d.cost σ) w) ∧
      (∀ (u : CommodityClassification.CESCost.Vec (k + 1)), (fderiv ℝ (d.cost σ) e.w) u = e.reconstruct p C i ⬝ᵥ u) ∧
        (∀ (j l : Fin (k + 1)),
            CommodityClassification.CESCost.pricePartial (CommodityClassification.CESCost.pricePartial (d.cost σ) j) l
                e.w =
              σ *
                (e.reconstruct p C i j * e.reconstruct p C i l / p i -
                  if j = l then e.reconstruct p C i j / e.w j else 0)) ∧
          ∀ (u v : CommodityClassification.CESCost.Vec (k + 1)),
            (fderiv ℝ (fun w => (fderiv ℝ (d.cost σ) w) v) e.w) u =
              σ *
                (e.reconstruct p C i ⬝ᵥ u * e.reconstruct p C i ⬝ᵥ v / p i -
                  ∑ j, e.reconstruct p C i j / e.w j * u j * v j)

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.local_utility_optimum

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/EquilibriumLocalApplication.lean:12

∀ {n : ℕ} (p q : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec n)
  (D : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Mat n n),
  Matrix.PosDef D →
    ∀ (utility : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec n → ℝ) (c : ℝ),
      ∀ U ∈ nhds q,
        (∀ r ∈ U, utility r = c + CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.quadraticUtility p D (r - q)) →
          ∀ᶠ (v : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec n) in nhds p,
            CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.affineDemand p q D v ∈ U ∧
              (∀ r ∈ U,
                  utility r - v ⬝ᵥ r ≤
                    utility (CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.affineDemand p q D v) -
                      v ⬝ᵥ CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.affineDemand p q D v) ∧
                ∀ r ∈ U,
                  r ≠ CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.affineDemand p q D v →
                    utility r - v ⬝ᵥ r <
                      utility (CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.affineDemand p q D v) -
                        v ⬝ᵥ CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.affineDemand p q D v

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

            (CommodityClassification.FixedCancellation.family.model E).lossCoefficient ∧
          (CommodityClassification.FixedCancellation.family.model C).m ≠
              (CommodityClassification.FixedCancellation.family.model E).m ∧
            (CommodityClassification.FixedCancellation.family.model C).K ≠
                (CommodityClassification.FixedCancellation.family.model E).K ∧
              (CommodityClassification.FixedCancellation.family.model C).BenchmarkEquilibrium
                  (CommodityClassification.FixedCancellation.family.commonUtility c)
                  (CommodityClassification.FixedCancellation.family.commonEndowment s0) s0 ∧
                (CommodityClassification.FixedCancellation.family.model E).BenchmarkEquilibrium
                  (CommodityClassification.FixedCancellation.family.commonUtility c)
                  (CommodityClassification.FixedCancellation.family.commonEndowment s0) s0

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/LocalCompetitiveImplementation.lean:14

∀ {n k g : ℕ}
  (E : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Model n k),
  E.DemandC1 →
    ∀ (P : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Partition n g) (J : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Mat g k),
      P.report E.q E.C = J →
        (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < E.q i) →
          (∀ (j : Fin (k + 1)), 0 < CommodityClassification.Supply.totalInputs E.q E.A j) →
            Matrix.PosDef E.D →
              0 < E.sigma →
                (∀ (j : Fin (k + 1)), 0 ≤ E.frame.a0 j) →
                  ∀ (s0 : ℝ),
                    0 < s0 →
                      E.demand = CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.affineDemand E.p E.q E.D →
                        ∀ (utility : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec n → ℝ) (c : ℝ),
                          ∀ U ∈ nhds E.q,
                            (∀ r ∈ U,
                                utility r =
                                  c + CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.quadraticUtility E.p E.D (r - E.q)) →
                              ∃ u s,
                                E.PositiveLocalPath s0 u s ∧
                                  (∃ I,
                                      IsOpen I ∧
                                        0 ∈ I ∧ ∀ t ∈ I, E.CompetitiveState utility U (E.endowment s0) (t, u t) (s t)) ∧
                                    HasDerivAt u E.zSolution 0 ∧
                                      HasDerivAt s E.sSolution 0 ∧
                                        HasDerivAt (fun t => E.quantities (t, u t)) E.qSolution 0 ∧
                                          E.WelfareExpansion utility u s

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/NestedBenchmarkWelfare.lean:52

∀ {n k h g : ℕ}
  (F : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.BenchmarkFamily n k h)
  (G : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Partition n g) (η : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec g)
  (hη : ∀ (a : Fin g), 0 < η a) (DG : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Mat g g),
  Matrix.PosDef DG →
    ∀ (hD : F.D = (F.nestData G η hη).demandMatrix DG),
      0 < n →
        ∀ (C : F.Candidate) (s0 c : ℝ),
          0 < s0 →
            have E := F.nestedModel G η hη DG hD C;
            ∃ u s,
              E.PositiveLocalPath s0 u s ∧
                E.WelfareNeighborhood s0 ((F.nestData G η hη).nestedUtility DG c) u s ∧
                  HasDerivAt (fun t => E.quantities (t, u t)) E.qSolution 0 ∧
                    E.WelfareExpansion ((F.nestData G η hη).nestedUtility DG c) u s

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

∀ {n k h g r : ℕ}
  (F : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.BenchmarkFamily n k h),

      (hη : ∀ (a : Fin g), 0 < η a) (DG : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Mat g g),
      Matrix.IsSymm DG →
        ∀ (β : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec g),
          F.D = (F.nestData G η hη).demandMatrix DG →

              ∀ (P : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Partition n r)

                              (F.model C).lossCoefficient - (F.model C0).lossCoefficient =
                                F.pairMismatchDelta G η i j t * (u ⬝ᵥ (F.model C0).K⁻¹.mulVec (F.model C0).m) ^ 2 /

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/NestedOriginalUtilityWitness.lean:31

∀ {n k h g r : ℕ}
  (F : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.BenchmarkFamily n k h)
  (G : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Partition n g) (η : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec g)
  (hη : ∀ (a : Fin g), 0 < η a) (DG : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Mat g g)
  (hD : F.D = (F.nestData G η hη).demandMatrix DG),
  Matrix.PosDef DG →
    ∀ (β : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec g),
      F.b = (F.nestData G η hη).proportionalPolicy β →
        ∀ (P : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Partition n r)
          (RP : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Refinement P F.parents)
          (RG : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Refinement P G),
          ¬F.ParentIdentified →
            ∀ (i j : Fin n),
              i ≠ j →
                P.group i = P.group j →
                  η (G.group i) ≠ F.sigma →
                    ∀ (s0 c : ℝ),
                      0 < s0 →
                        ∃ C0,
                          P.mean F.p F.q ↑C0 = ↑C0 ∧
                            (F.nestedModel G η hη DG hD C0).m ≠ 0 ∧
                              ∀ V ∈ nhds 0,
                                ∃ t ∈ V,
                                  t ≠ 0 ∧
                                    ∃ C,
                                      ↑C = F.pairExchange C0 i j (F.responseY C0) t ∧
                                        F.NestedSameObservationWitness G η hη DG hD P C C0 s0 c

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/NormalizedWidthStability.lean:12

∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} (S : Set A),
  S.Nonempty →
    ∀ (O : A → B) (f f0 : A → ℝ),
      CommodityClassification.Information.BoundedValues S f0 →
        ∀ (e ν0 ν alo ahi : ℝ),
          0 < ν0 →
            0 < ν →
              0 < alo →
                0 < ahi →
                  alo * ν0 ≤ ν →
                    ν ≤ ahi * ν0 →
                      (∀ x ∈ S, |f x - f0 x| ≤ e * ν0) →
                        (max ((CommodityClassification.Information.worstWidth S O fun x => f0 x / ν0) - 2 * e) 0 / ahi ≤
                            CommodityClassification.Information.worstWidth S O fun x => f x / ν) ∧
                          (CommodityClassification.Information.worstWidth S O fun x => f x / ν) ≤
                            ((CommodityClassification.Information.worstWidth S O fun x => f0 x / ν0) + 2 * e) / alo

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

∀ {n g : ℕ}
  (d : CommodityClassification.Precision.Data n) (P : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Partition n g),

      d.Admissible c →
        e ∈ d.closedFiber P (d.groupTotal P c) →
          IsMaxOn d.secondMoment (d.closedFiber P (d.groupTotal P c)) e →
            ∀ (eps : ℝ),
              d.manuscriptAnswerWidth P (d.groupTotal P c) ≤ eps ↔
                d.lossScale * d.theta c ^ 2 *
                    |1 / d.denominator d.sigma (d.lowerMoment P (d.groupTotal P c)) (d.theta c ^ 2) -
                        1 / d.denominator d.sigma (d.secondMoment e) (d.theta c ^ 2)| ≤
                  eps

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/PrecisionManuscriptWidth.lean:53

∀ {n g : ℕ}
  (d : CommodityClassification.Precision.Data n) (P : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Partition n g),
  d.TypeRespecting P →
    ∀ (c e : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Vec n),
      d.Admissible c →
        e ∈ d.closedFiber P (d.groupTotal P c) →
          IsMaxOn d.secondMoment (d.closedFiber P (d.groupTotal P c)) e →
            d.manuscriptAnswerWidth P (d.groupTotal P c) =
              d.lossScale * d.theta c ^ 2 *
                |1 / d.denominator d.sigma (d.lowerMoment P (d.groupTotal P c)) (d.theta c ^ 2) -
                    1 / d.denominator d.sigma (d.secondMoment e) (d.theta c ^ 2)|

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

∀ {n : ℕ}
  (d : CommodityClassification.Precision.Data n) {A : Type u_1} (O : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Vec n → A)

          ProbabilityTheory.variance d.normalizedWelfare μ

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/PrecisionUniformPositiveWitnesses.lean:38

∀ {n g : ℕ}
  (d : CommodityClassification.Precision.Data n) (P : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Partition n g) (t : ℝ),
  0 ≤ t →
    t < 1 →
      ∃ c,
        d.Admissible c ∧
          d.groupTotal P c = d.groupTotal P d.criticalInputs ∧
            d.theta c = d.theta d.criticalInputs ∧
              (∀ (i : Fin n) (j : Fin 2),
                  d.shareFloor t ≤ d.inputs d.criticalInputs i j ∧ d.shareFloor t ≤ d.inputs c i j) ∧
                d.interpolatedWidth t (d.coarseMoment g) ≤
                  |d.normalizedWelfare d.criticalInputs - d.normalizedWelfare c|

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

CommodityClassification.Precision.Data.uniform_positive_witnesses

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/PrecisionUniformPositiveWitnesses.lean:69

∀ {n : ℕ}
  (d : CommodityClassification.Precision.Data n) {N : ℕ → ℕ}
  (E : (j : ℕ) → CommodityClassification.Precision.Data (N j)) (m : ℕ → ℕ),
  (∀ (j : ℕ), (E j).eta = d.eta) →
    (∀ (j : ℕ), (E j).alpha = d.alpha) →
      (∀ (j : ℕ), (E j).beta = d.beta) →
        (∀ (j : ℕ), (E j).sigma = d.sigma) →
          Filter.Tendsto (fun j => (E j).coarseSales (m j)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
            ∀ eps < d.precisionFloor,
              ∃ t δ,
                0 ≤ t ∧
                  t < 1 ∧
                    δ = d.shareFloor t ∧
                      0 < δ ∧
                        ∀ᶠ (j : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                          ∀ (P : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Partition (N j) (m j)),
                            ∃ c,
                              (E j).Admissible c ∧
                                (E j).groupTotal P c = (E j).groupTotal P (E j).criticalInputs ∧
                                  (E j).theta c = (E j).theta (E j).criticalInputs ∧
                                    (∀ (i : Fin (N j)) (a : Fin 2),
                                        δ ≤ (E j).inputs (E j).criticalInputs i a ∧ δ ≤ (E j).inputs c i a) ∧
                                      eps < |(E j).normalizedWelfare (E j).criticalInputs - (E j).normalizedWelfare c|

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

CommodityClassification.Precision.Data.uniform_actual_witnesses

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/PrecisionUniformPositiveWitnesses.lean:90

∀ {n : ℕ}
  (d : CommodityClassification.Precision.Data n) {N : ℕ → ℕ}
  (E : (j : ℕ) → CommodityClassification.Precision.Data (N j)) (m : ℕ → ℕ),

        (∀ (j : ℕ), (E j).sigma = d.sigma) →
          Filter.Tendsto (fun j => (E j).coarseSales (m j)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
            ∀ eps < d.precisionFloor,
              ∃ δ,
                0 < δ ∧
                  ∀ᶠ (j : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                    ∀ (P : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Partition (N j) (m j)),
                      ∃ c,
                        ∃ (hc : (E j).Admissible c),

∀ {n : ℕ}
  (d : CommodityClassification.Precision.Data n) (c : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Vec n)
  (hc : d.Admissible c) (s0 a : ℝ),
  0 < s0 →
    have E := d.family.model (d.candidate c hc);
    ∃ u s,
      E.PositiveLocalPath s0 u s ∧
        (∃ I,
            IsOpen I ∧
              0 ∈ I ∧
                ∀ t ∈ I,
                  E.CompetitiveState (d.family.commonUtility a) Set.univ (d.family.commonEndowment s0) (t, u t) (s t)) ∧
          (fun t =>
              E.welfare (d.family.commonUtility a) u s 0 - E.welfare (d.family.commonUtility a) u s t -
                1 / 2 * t ^ 2 * (d.nu * d.normalizedWelfare c)) =o[nhds 0]
            fun t => t ^ 2

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/PredictionRiskDecomposition.lean:15

∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace A]
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure A) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (f : A → ℝ),
  MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 μ →
    ∀ (a : ℝ),
      CommodityClassification.Information.predictionRisk μ f a =
        (a - ∫ (x : A), f x ∂μ) ^ 2 + ProbabilityTheory.variance f μ

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.BenchmarkFamily.observationWidth_perturbation

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/RobustEconomicWidth.lean:38

∀ {n k g : ℕ}
  (F : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.BenchmarkFamily n k g) {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} (S : Set A),
  S.Nonempty →
    ∀ (O : A → B) (C : A → CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Mat n k),
      (∀ x ∈ S, C x ∈ F.frame.Candidates F.p F.q F.parents F.report) →
        ∀ (D : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Mat n n) (b : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec n) (δ τ : ℝ),
          0 ≤ δ →
            ∀ (hδ1 : δ < 1),
              0 ≤ τ →
                τ < 1 →
                  ∀ (hlo : Matrix.PosSemidef (D - (1 - δ) • F.D)),
                    Matrix.PosSemidef ((1 + δ) • F.D - D) →
                      (b - F.b) ⬝ᵥ Matrix.mulVec F.D (b - F.b) ≤ τ ^ 2 * F.benchmarkEnergy →
                        (∀ (j : Fin (k + 1)),
                            0 <
                              CommodityClassification.Supply.totalInputs F.q (F.frame.reconstruct F.p F.reference) j) →
                          0 < F.benchmarkEnergy →
                            have G := F.withDemandPolicy D ⋯ b;
                            max (F.observationWidth S O C - 2 * CommodityClassification.Robust.errorConstant δ τ) 0 /
                                  CommodityClassification.Robust.normalizationUpper δ τ ≤
                                G.observationWidth S O C ∧
                              G.observationWidth S O C ≤
                                (F.observationWidth S O C + 2 * CommodityClassification.Robust.errorConstant δ τ) /
                                  CommodityClassification.Robust.normalizationLower δ τ

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/WeightedPairRestrictions.lean:93

∀ {n g r : ℕ}
  (P : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Partition n g) (q : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Vec n),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < q i) →
    ∀ (H : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.HiddenBasis (P.Q q) r)
      (L : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Mat n n)
      (S : Submodule ℝ (CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Vec n)),
      (∀ (j : Fin r), (fun i => (L * H.N) i j) ∈ S) ↔
        ∀ (i j : Fin n), P.group i = P.group j → (fun a => L a i / q i - L a j / q j) ∈ S

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/WelfareApplication.lean:27

∀ {n k : ℕ}
  (E : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Model n k) (h : E.DemandC1) (hK : Matrix.PosDef E.K),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < E.q i) →
    ∀ (s0 : ℝ),
      0 < s0 →
        Matrix.PosDef E.D →
          E.demand = CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.affineDemand E.p E.q E.D →
            ∀ (utility : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec n → ℝ) (c : ℝ),
              ∀ U ∈ nhds E.q,
                (∀ r ∈ U, utility r = c + CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.quadraticUtility E.p E.D (r - E.q)) →
                  E.QuadraticWelfareNeighborhood s0 utility U (E.localPricePath h hK s0) (E.localNumerairePath h hK s0)

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Model.ofAffine_welfare

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/WelfareApplication.lean:62

∀ {n k g : ℕ}
  (e : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Frame k) (p q : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec n)
  (C : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Mat n k) (D : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Mat n n)
  (b : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec n) (σ : ℝ) (hp : ∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < p i)
  (hw : ∀ (j : Fin (k + 1)), 0 < e.w j) (hC : C ∈ e.PositiveDomain p)
  (P : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Partition n g) (J : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Mat g k),
  P.report q C = J →
    (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < q i) →
      (∀ (j : Fin (k + 1)), 0 < CommodityClassification.Supply.totalInputs q (e.reconstruct p C) j) →
        Matrix.PosDef D →
          0 < σ →
            ∀ (s0 : ℝ),
              0 < s0 →
                ∀ (utility : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec n → ℝ) (c : ℝ),
                  ∀ U ∈ nhds q,
                    (∀ r ∈ U, utility r = c + CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.quadraticUtility p D (r - q)) →
                      have E := CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Model.ofAffine e p q C D b σ hp hw hC;
                      ∃ u s, E.PositiveLocalPath s0 u s ∧ E.QuadraticWelfareNeighborhood s0 utility U u s

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Model.constructed_welfare_taylor

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/WelfareExpansion.lean:18

∀ {n k : ℕ}
  (E : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Model n k) (h : E.DemandC1) (hK : Matrix.PosDef E.K),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < E.q i) →
    ∀ (s0 : ℝ),
      0 < s0 →
        ∀ (utility : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec n → ℝ),
          E.UtilityCompatible utility →
            have u := E.localPricePath h hK s0;
            have s := E.localNumerairePath h hK s0;
            (fun t =>
                E.welfare utility u s 0 - E.welfare utility u s t -
                  1 / 2 * t ^ 2 * -(E.b ⬝ᵥ deriv (fun x => E.quantities (x, u x)) 0)) =o[nhds 0]
              fun t => t ^ 2

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

  (hreport : P.report E.q E.C = J) (hq : ∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < E.q i)
  (hI : ∀ (j : Fin (k + 1)), 0 < CommodityClassification.Supply.totalInputs E.q E.A j) (hD : Matrix.PosDef E.D)
  (hσ : 0 < E.sigma) (s0 : ℝ),
  0 < s0 →

  (E : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Model n k) (abar : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec (k + 1))
  (utility : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec n → ℝ) (u : ℝ → CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec k)
  (s : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (z : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec k) (ds : ℝ)
  (dQ : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec n),
  HasDerivAt u z t →
    HasDerivAt s ds t →
      HasDerivAt (fun x => E.quantities (x, u x)) dQ t →
        E.currentPrice (u t) ∈ CommodityClassification.CESCost.PositivePrices (k + 1) →
          (∀ᶠ (x : ℝ) in nhds t, E.excess abar ((x, u x), s x) = 0) →
            HasFDerivAt utility (CommodityClassification.CESCost.weightedLinear (E.prices (t, u t)))
                (E.quantities (t, u t)) →
              HasDerivAt (E.welfare utility u s) (t * E.b ⬝ᵥ dQ) t

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/WelfareVariationalApplication.lean:12

∀ {n k g : ℕ}
  (E : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Model n k),
  E.DemandC1 →
    ∀ (P : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Partition n g) (J : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Mat g k),
      P.report E.q E.C = J →
        (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < E.q i) →
          (∀ (j : Fin (k + 1)), 0 < CommodityClassification.Supply.totalInputs E.q E.A j) →
            Matrix.PosDef E.D →
              0 < E.sigma →
                ∀ (s0 : ℝ),
                  0 < s0 →
                    ∀ (utility : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec n → ℝ),
                      E.UtilityCompatible utility →
                        ∃ u s,
                          E.PositiveLocalPath s0 u s ∧
                            E.WelfareNeighborhood s0 utility u s ∧
                              HasDerivAt u E.zSolution 0 ∧
                                HasDerivAt (fun t => E.quantities (t, u t)) E.qSolution 0 ∧
                                  E.WelfareExpansion utility u s ∧ E.VariationalCertificate

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

theorem · LeanMath/CommodityClassification/WelfareVariationalApplication.lean:49

∀ {n k g : ℕ}
  (e : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Frame k) (p q : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec n)
  (C : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Mat n k) (D : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Mat n n)
  (b : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec n) (σ : ℝ) (hp : ∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < p i)
  (hw : ∀ (j : Fin (k + 1)), 0 < e.w j) (hC : C ∈ e.PositiveDomain p)
  (P : CommodityClassification.InputCoordinates.Partition n g) (J : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Mat g k),
  P.report q C = J →
    (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < q i) →
      (∀ (j : Fin (k + 1)), 0 < CommodityClassification.Supply.totalInputs q (e.reconstruct p C) j) →
        Matrix.PosDef D →
          0 < σ →
            ∀ (s0 : ℝ),
              0 < s0 →
                ∀ (utility : CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Vec n → ℝ) (c : ℝ),
                  ∀ U ∈ nhds q,
                    (∀ r ∈ U, utility r = c + CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.quadraticUtility p D (r - q)) →
                      have E := CommodityClassification.Equilibrium.Model.ofAffine e p q C D b σ hp hw hC;
                      ∃ u s,
                        E.PositiveLocalPath s0 u s ∧
                          E.QuadraticWelfareNeighborhood s0 utility U u s ∧
                            HasDerivAt u E.zSolution 0 ∧
                              HasDerivAt (fun t => E.quantities (t, u t)) E.qSolution 0 ∧
                                E.WelfareExpansion utility u s ∧ E.VariationalCertificate

Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound
